name: Komatex foamed PVC board (3 mm project board)
note: Kommerling's Komatex data sheet: apparent density 0.55 to 0.65 g/cm3, modulus of elasticity 850 to 1100 N/mm2; the record holds the middle of each range. Price per kilogram derived from the Home Depot 5-pack of 24 x 36 x 0.118 in. boards ($57.34) at that density.

price.note: Derived: $57.34 for five boards of 1.67 L each at 600 kg/m3.
